name: Spark Doctor
description: Collect DGX Spark diagnostics and explain likely system, runtime, network, and recipe problems from local evidence.
compatibility: DGX Spark system and Docker diagnostics; JSON and Markdown reports.
limitations: Read-only diagnostics, not automatic repairs; requires Python 3.11 or newer.
Review and anonymize diagnostic reports before sharing them.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
